record.paper_title: Billiard dynamics: A survey with the emphasis on open problems
record.original_question: Are ellipses the only closed convex plane curves with the following transitivity property of the gardener construction: whenever γ_2 is obtained from γ_1 by the string construction with one string length and γ_3 is obtained from γ_2 by the string construction with another string length, there is a single string length that produces γ_3 directly from γ_1?

evidence.quote: Задача 1b. Эллипсы — это единственные замкнутые выпуклые кривые, удовлетворяющие вышеуказанной транзитивности.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let γ be a closed convex plane curve. For any positive real number ℓ greater than the perimeter of γ, the string construction (also called the gardener construction) applied to γ with string length ℓ produces a new closed convex curve γ' as follows: γ' is the locus of points p such that the shortest closed loop made of the curve γ together with two taut string segments from p winding around γ has total length equal to ℓ; equivalently, γ' is the boundary of the region traced by a pencil that keeps a closed loop of string of length ℓ taut around γ.

Say that γ has the transitivity property if, whenever γ₂ is obtained from γ₁ := γ by the string construction with some string length ℓ₁, and γ₃ is obtained from γ₂ by the string construction with some string length ℓ₂, there exists a single string length ℓ₃ such that applying the string construction to γ₁ with string length ℓ₃ directly produces γ₃.

It is known that every ellipse satisfies this transitivity property (the resulting curves are confocal ellipses).

Question: Are ellipses the only closed convex plane curves having this transitivity property?
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface a published proof or counterexample resolving whether ellipses are the unique closed convex plane curves for which iterated gardener/string constructions are transitive in the string-length parameter. The problem is posed as an open problem in surveys on billiard dynamics, and no resolution was found.

status_evidence.title: Billiard dynamics: A survey with the emphasis on open problems (zbMATH)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open problems on billiards, including questions on the string construction and characterizations of ellipses.
status_evidence.claim: The transitivity characterization of ellipses by the string construction is listed among the open problems.
